D01.instruction: Report the folio vellum fee posted on the quire rubric sheet.

D02.instruction: Report the quire recto due on the morocco gilt sheet.

D03.instruction: Name the uncial keeper listed on the flyleaf colophon card.

D04.instruction: Give the bind status for the pressmark gathering slip.

D05.instruction: Report the morocco gilt fee on the palimpsest incunable sheet.

D06.instruction: Sum the folio vellum crate costs that the quire rubric note lists.

D07.instruction: Sum the recto flyleaf crate costs that the colophon note lists.

D08.instruction: Sum the codex rubric crate counts that the palimpsest roster lists.

D09.instruction: Sum the quire colophon shift hours that the morocco card lists.

D10.instruction: Sum the verso palimpsest crate counts that the rubric roster lists.

D11.instruction: Report the live folio crate total from the finance sheet, not the mail quote.

D12.instruction: Report the live quire gilt total from the finance sheet, not the mail quote.

D13.instruction: Name the live recto rubric clerk from the roster sheet, not the mail copy.

D14.instruction: Give the live incunable palimpsest mark from the yard card, not the mail mark.

D15.instruction: Report the live morocco bin total from the finance sheet, not the mail quote.

D16.instruction: Report the crate cost for the verso yard rush crate on the rubric sheet.

D17.instruction: Report the crate cost for the folio yard sealed crate on the palimpsest sheet.

D18.instruction: Name the night uncial clerk tagged on the gathering index.

D19.instruction: Give the slip mark for the long recto pressmark berth.

D20.instruction: Report the shift hours for the rush verso watch on the colophon card.

D21.instruction: Count the folio rubric shifts on the calendar that also appear on the palimpsest roster.

D22.instruction: Count the rush uncial notes in the mail that also appear on the rubric sheet.

D23.instruction: Count the codex palimpsest shifts on the calendar that also appear on the quire card.

D24.instruction: Count the verso quire crates on the sheet that also appear on the morocco note.

D25.instruction: Count the gilt rubric notes in the mail that also appear on the colophon sheet.

D26.instruction: Name the folio gathering clerk who appears on the rubric sheet, the palimpsest card, and the uncial tag.

D27.instruction: Name the verso rubric hand who appears on the gilt sheet, the colophon card, and the morocco tag.

D28.instruction: Give the recto palimpsest mark that appears on the quire sheet, the flyleaf card, and the folio tag.

D29.instruction: Report the colophon rubric fee that appears on the live sheet, the palimpsest index, and the gathering tag.

D30.instruction: Report the morocco incunable due that appears on the live sheet, the flyleaf index, and the quire tag.
